:::{#exm-set-operations}
#### Combining sets of die rolls

Let $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$ (the even rolls) and $B = \set{1, 2, 3}$ (the rolls of at most 3).
Then:

- $A \cup B = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 6}$, the rolls that are even or at most 3;
- $A \cap B = \set{2}$, the only roll that is both;
- $A \setminus B = \set{4, 6}$, the even rolls greater than 3;
- $\set{2, 4, 6} \cap \set{1, 3, 5} = \emptyset$: no roll is both even and odd.

:::
